request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Maintain and enhance Pallas by TxPipe, described as Cardano core Rust libraries, for a 12-month Year 2 grant period.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total withdrawal of 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates that re-implement core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, networking, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
Pallas is used as shared infrastructure by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The Pallas repository has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 downloads on crates.io.
The maintainer scope includes essential codebase maintenance, community support, and AI-driven development workflow compatibility resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 on its own or in aggregate.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with administration fees covering oversight costs.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style authorization rules, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for community tracking.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Pallas maintenance and enhancement through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, emphasizing Pallas as open-source Cardano Rust infrastructure with ecosystem usage, governance-process approval, NCL compliance, and oversight mechanisms.
